Terms must untransformed variable names interactions (written :), every component interaction must also appear main effect. Lower bounds must positive integers, upper bounds must positive integers Inf, lower bounds must exceed upper bounds. status outcome determined follows: bounds NA – missing outcome, lower == upper – exactly observed outcome, upper == Inf – right-censored outcome, .e., outcome least lower (e.g., lower = 2 upper = Inf represent "2 "), otherwise – interval-censored outcome, .e., outcome lies lower upper (inclusive). Missing censored outcomes assumed missing coarsened random given variables outcome_formula. least one outcome must observed censored. outcome_formula one-sided formula intercept logarithm mean untruncated outcome distribution. may contain variables capture_formula capture indicators, .latent (latent_classes > 1), interactions (whose components must also appear main effects). must supplied outcome NULL must NULL otherwise. outcome_dist zero-truncated outcome distribution: "ztnegbin" (zero-truncated negative binomial, default) "ztpois" (zero-truncated Poisson). "ztnegbin", untruncated distribution mean \(\mu\) variance \(\mu + \sigma \mu^2\), \(\sigma > 0\) dispersion parameter. misclass NULL (misclassification) named list one element per categorical variable subject misclassification. name must column data used capture_formula outcome_formula, column must factor character vector without missing values. element list following components: matrix – square confusion matrix whose row column names contain category levels order. Rows correspond true categories columns observed categories, .e., element [g, h] probability observing category h true category g. Entries must finite non-negative, row must sum 1. observed levels variable must appear matrix. row names define true categories used model. true_if (optional) – one-sided formula capture variables joined +, e.g., ~ source_1. title: Fit a Capture-Recapture Model — crc_fit
code: set.seed(123) N <- 1000 population <- data.frame(   source_1 = rbinom(N, 1, 0.5),   source_2 = rbinom(N, 1, 0.4),   source_3 = rbinom(N, 1, 0.3),   group = sample(c("a", "b"), N, replace = TRUE) ) population$outcome <- 1 + rpois(N, ifelse(population$group == "a", 1, 3))  # Keep only the units captured by at least one source sources <- c("source_1", "source_2", "source_3") data <- population[rowSums(population[, sources]) > 0, ] data$outcome[sample(nrow(data), 50)] <- NA  fit <- crc_fit(   data,   captures = ~ source_1 + source_2 + source_3,   capture_formula = ~ source_1 + source_2 + source_3 + group,   outcome = "outcome",   outcome_formula = ~ group ) fit #> Capture-recapture model fit #>  #> Observed units:          791 #> Capture sources:         source_1, source_2, source_3 #> Latent classes:          1 #> Misclassified variables: none #> Outcome distribution:    zero-truncated negative binomial #> EM algorithm:            converged after 34 iterations predict(fit, by = ~ group) #> Capture-recapture prediction #>  #> Population size:         1,020 #> Outcome total:           2,978 #> Grouping variables:      group #> Groups:                  2 #>  #> Grouped estimates: #>     group population_size outcome_total #>    <fctr>           <num>         <num> #> 1:      a           499.0         980.1 #> 2:      b           520.9        1998.2
